what: The Bopl blob kings the player picks at run start in 9 Kings. Bopl's blob look (color) and every ability name/description are read at runtime from the player's installed copy of Bopl Battle via boplRef; nothing from Bopl is copied into this mod.
kingNamePolicy: King names are mashup text (Bopl has no named characters); colors resolve from Bopl's player-color table.

rows.name: Crimson King
rows.passiveEffect: Each ring-out your army scores grants +10% attack for the rest of the battle (stacks)

rows.name: Azure King
rows.passiveEffect: Your units cannot be knocked back by ring-out force below their own attack value

rows.name: Verdant King
rows.passiveEffect: Blob units heal 2 HP at the start of every battle round
